records.user_scope_quote: 本游戏混乱畸变下该英雄共同的机制

H10.first_activation: hero preparation at same stage as hunter preparation; random3 eligible stable bodies, player chooses1 and first shadow succeeds immediately; preparationT0, not a formal action
H10.second_activation: in permitted own pre-main window, random uniformly1 from current eligible surviving own bodies, excluding active host/public shadow; may transfer while first shadow remains
H10.transfer: one true general; prior host survives/restores body; existing public shadow not recreated; no flow from transfer; successful second disables flow-dance
H10.cooldown: own normal formalT1..T7 unavailable; T8 cooldown met; still needs legal window/pool/other conditions; extra/forced/skill children do not advance formal count
H10.empty_pool: reject without commit, second successful use consumption, main-action consumption, new cooldown or changes to host/shadow; existing first flow-dance preserved; may try again later in allowed window if a legal pool exists
H10.locator: first candidate/body location markers private to wind player only; disappear after choice and successful first activation; no persistent host marker, no secret type/faction label
H10.retained: max2 successful uses; flow and death-source rules otherwise retained; first already flowed does not itself remove second eligibility
not_decided: preparation decline/timeout/failure and candidate shortage/sampling details

H05_M07.scope: all modes where H05 and M07 are available; no new mode-pool approval
H05_M07.target: opponent immediately preceding eligible formal-action body must still be alive and currently opponent-controlled at activation; converted own body is ineligible; cannot skip to older action
H05_M07.other_source_constraints: unchanged; failure/fee/other lifecycle edges not newly approved

H06.preflight: at least1 legally permitted same-body nonattack noncheck replay exists in the restored source state
H06.if_no_legal_replay: do not restore board/identity/resources, spend the one use or consume main action; continue original current turn and original deadline without refresh
H06.preserved: existing10sec/not-in-check/window/snapshot/min(remaining,10) constraints; unknown or incomplete enumeration is not proof of no replay; no extra secret-state disclosure

H10_half_chaos_clarification.scope: half_chaos restoration and clarification; not an extra three-mode business approval
H10_half_chaos_clarification.eligibility: current true own faction AND current own controller; active host remains faction/control anchored; actual secret enemy cannot be selected to conceal information feedback

half_chaos_local.H03: qualifying successful departure awards barrier and charges quota before same-atom landing death; death does not refund quota
half_chaos_local.H11_H02_M03: still-valid old assassination chance may continue after shuffle while covered, using current public covered-position geometry, normal reveal/control after landing; no duration refresh, no new covered activation
half_chaos_local.H10_retired_host: second-transfer old still-covered host re-enters general M07 random at next normal begin of either side, no extra random/reveal during transfer; face-up stays revealed-locked; new active host remains anchored
